items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Art Blakey, Freddie Hubbard, McCoy Tyner, everybody, Lee Morgan. Everybody worked in there.

ctx.x: Oh, Slug’s, I’ve heard this name, yes.

A tiny club. I mean it was bigger than this room, but not that much. It had sawdust all over the floor and you could get a beer for a dollar, and all the major groups were there. Art Blakey, Freddie Hubbard, McCoy Tyner, everybody, Lee Morgan. Everybody worked in there. And I lived right around the corner. So but I lived up like six flights of stairs, and I had four kids in five years, and they were very young, so I didn’t get out too often. So one night I heard that Art Blakey was there and I though oh I’ve got…
Oh, that’s fantastic. Who was in the band at that point?
